instruction: Get all languages at /api/languages. How many languages are supported?
Get translation history at /api/history. How many history entries?
Search history at /api/history?q=hello. How many results?
Filter history by source language at /api/history?source_lang=en. How many?
Get saved translations at /api/saved. How many saved items?
Get glossaries at /api/glossaries. How many glossaries exist?
POST /api/translate with text='Hello world', source='en', target='es'. Does it return translated text?
POST /api/detect with text='Hello good morning'. What language is detected?
POST /api/settings/toggle with user_id=1, setting=auto_detect. Does it toggle?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total translations?
Get history with limit at /api/history?limit=5. Are results sorted by timestamp desc?
Export history at /api/export?format=csv. Does it return CSV data?
POST /api/glossaries with name='Test Glossary', user_id=1, source_lang=en, target_lang=fr. Does it create?
POST /api/saved with user_id=1, source_lang=en, target_lang=es, source_text='Test', translated_text='Prueba'. Does it save?
PUT /api/glossaries/1 with name='Updated Glossary'. Does it update the name?
DELETE /api/glossaries/1. Does it delete the glossary?
Search history semantically at /api/history/semantic?q=greeting morning. Does it return results?
POST /api/playback with text='Hello world', lang='en', speed=1.0. Does it return audio metadata?
POST /api/login with username and password of a valid user. Does it return user_id?
POST /api/history with user_id=1, source_lang=en, target_lang=de, source_text='Good night', translated_text='Gute Nacht'. Does it create?
